messages:
deploy-bot: rollout started: release/2026-03-15-omega -> canary (5% traffic)

Priya (SRE): seeing spike in 502s for canary services in eu-west-1. Logs indicate KMS:AccessDenied on decrypt.

Priya (SRE): log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T15:04:12Z ERROR kms_client: Decrypt failed for keyId=alias/app/key - AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/redwood-service is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/rotated-xyz
```

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: severity=P1 -> paging @Alex (oncall). Reason: canary decrypt errors causing 502s.

Alex (oncall): acked. Jumping in. @Liam did deploy touch KMS alias change?

Liam (Deploy): I rolled in updated env var KMS_KEY=rotated-xyz as part of secrets refresh. No infra IAM changes in the release. Canary started at 15:03.

Priya (SRE): evidence points to key rotation that happened 15:02Z. The service role doesn't have kms:Decrypt for the rotated key yet.

Tess (Support): Support seeing error traces from customers in eu-west-1; estimating impact now.

Alex (oncall): mitigation options: emergency rollback OR flip config flag to disable key-based decrypt path and use stable fallback. Which is fastest?

Liam (Deploy): rollback is quickest from CD. I can trigger rollback and block further rollouts. Also can push config kill-switch if rollback stumbles.

deploy-bot: initiating rollback for release/2026-03-15-omega -> rollback id rbk-omega-3838

Priya (SRE): applying kill-switch just in case: set `feature.kms_newkey_enabled=false` for canary scope.

deploy-bot: config change applied cfg-omega-3838. Canary now routed to stable key path.

Priya (SRE): metrics: canary error rate peaked at 6.1% in eu-west-1 between 15:03-15:06. After rollback + kill-switch error rate fell to 0.3% by 15:08.

Tess (Support): initial customer-impact check: ~1.7% of requests in eu-west-1 saw 5xx due to KMS failures. Open tickets: 5 customers reported degraded tokens/embeds.

CS Rep: Notifying affected customers with temporary incident advisory. Draft: "Brief authentication and inference errors in EU due to a rotated KMS key mismatch during a canary rollout. We rolled back and restored service." Will send in 20m.

Alex (oncall): handing to Priya for mitigation verification and RCA. @Ravi please join for root cause and postmortem.

Ravi (Eng Lead): on it. Want a timeline and why CD picked up rotated key before IAM grants propagated.

Priya (SRE): short timeline:
- 15:01Z: KMS key rotation executed by ops (rotated-xyz created)
- 15:02Z: secrets-manager updated alias -> rotated-xyz
- 15:03Z: release/2026-03-15-omega started canary, reads KMS_KEY=rotated-xyz
- 15:03-15:06Z: canary requests fail with kms:Decrypt AccessDenied
- 15:06Z: rollback + kill-switch applied
- 15:08Z: errors drop to baseline

Liam (Deploy): follow-ups: change CD to not auto-pick new key IDs from secrets without cross-checking IAM grants. Add gating step: attempt kms:Decrypt during preflight under service role.

Priya (SRE): infra tasks: add preflight KMS smoke check, add a permission-propagation monitor after key rotation (alert if roles missing grants), and tighten rotation schedule to avoid coinciding with deploy windows.

Tess (Support): publishing status page update and contacting the five affected customers with tailored notes. ETA for status update: 25m.

Alex (oncall): incident state -> mitigated. Creating incident ticket.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0511 created, owner=Priya (SRE), status=mitigated.

Priya (SRE): postmortem docket: include RCA, timeline, and actions: (1) CD pin secrets to alias until IAM verification, (2) add canary preflight KMS decrypt test, (3) ops to include IAM grant step in rotation playbook, (4) update runbook to include immediate kill-switch + rollback steps for key/secret misconfig during deploys.

Ravi (Eng Lead): schedule 1h postmortem tomorrow 16:00Z. Assigning leads: Priya for SRE actions, Liam for CD changes, Ops for rotation playbook.

Tess (Support): will share customer outreach copy for review. Also logging support tickets for SLA review.

Alex (oncall): closing pager. Keep this thread updated with RCA doc link when available.

deploy-bot: rollback completed. release state: stable.

incident-bot: summary: canary rollout triggered new KMS key id before IAM grants were in place -> AccessDenied -> rollback + config kill-switch applied -> service restored.
